title: Performance Tuning
seo: Dashboard performance tuning and slow query fixes
meta: We find out why your dashboard is slow, then fix heavy queries and screens, with before and after timings. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: We measure where your dashboard loses time, then fix it. That usually means slow database queries, too many requests on one screen, large files sent to the browser or charts redrawing more than needed. You get a short before and after report with real timings, and we apply the safest fixes directly in your project, such as indexes, caching and loading data only when it is needed.

faq: Can you promise a specific speed?
No. We cannot promise a number because it depends on your data and hosting. We measure first, share the realistic target and report the real before and after timings.
Only with your approval. We try fixes on a copy first, and risky changes such as new indexes are explained and scheduled with you. We recommend a backup before going live.
Do you need access to my live data?
We ask for read access or a recent copy so we can see real query behavior. We do not need your passwords, and any copy is deleted when the work ends.
Is the slowness maybe my hosting plan?
It can be. If the main limit is server size, we say so and show the evidence. Upgrading is your decision, and we do not push plans that you do not need.
